format: Codex plain JSONL rollout records (session_meta, response_item, event_msg)

canonical.jsonl.normalization: Prefer response_item messages; retain user/assistant text and phase; exclude agent_message, reasoning, tool arguments and control records. Compressed rollout is unsupported.

tool_turns.jsonl.normalization: Preserve commentary/final phase. Link function_call_output to function_call only by call_id within the same explicit internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough.turn_id. Without turn identity, leave ownership unlinked. Canonical message/event duplicates emit one MessageEntry; repeated payload IDs have unique physical keys. Malformed complete records are warned and retained unknown; incomplete final bytes are not observed.
